summary: Remove an event listener by type, callback identity, and capture flag only.
caveats: Do not require all option fields to match; only capture participates in removal matching.

tests.name: capture must match
tests.input: const t=new EventTarget(); let n=0; const f=()=>n++; t.addEventListener('x',f,true); t.removeEventListener('x',f,false); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); console.log(n);

tests.name: passive option not part of removal key
tests.input: const t=new EventTarget(); let n=0; const f=()=>n++; t.addEventListener('x',f,{passive:true}); t.removeEventListener('x',f,{passive:false}); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); console.log(n);
